verdict.rationale: Signifyd is an API-first SaaS service. Its documented REST API covers authenticating, submitting orders (Checkout/Sale), retrieving decisions, polling and creating webhooks, so headless, programmatic automation is the product's own interaction model. Nothing addresses CI use specifically. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-runner tooling, documented CI/pipeline or sandbox test-environment guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
